offering_description.value: Dave offers short-term cash advances and mobile banking to U.S. consumers. It delivers these services through its app and works with partner banks to provide deposit accounts and debit cards.

primary_products.value: short-term cash advances; checking accounts; debit cards

primary_services.value: mobile banking; budgeting and balance alerts; side-gig referrals

customer_segment.value: B2C: U.S. consumers seeking cash between paydays or mobile banking

end_markets.value: consumer cash advances; retail banking; personal financial management; gig work

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Cash advance fees and interchange on debit card purchases; subscription: Recurring app membership fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Arranges cash advances and connects consumers with partner-bank accounts and debit cards; software / platform: Uses linked account data to show consumers their balances and spending activity

specialization.value: related lines: Cash advances, mobile banking, budgeting tools and side-gig referrals

distribution_channels.value: online: Dave’s mobile app, available through major app stores

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Cash advances and payment services face federal and state consumer protection rules, with deposit accounts provided by regulated partner banks.

notes: The current availability of side-gig referrals is uncertain.
